name: Kavach Pharmacogenomic Evidence Knowledge Base
purpose: Curated evidence layer for a hackathon prototype. It supports documented-case validation and mechanism-based new-drug screening.
important_limitations: This is not a clinical decision-support database.
Population frequency is not probability of adverse drug reaction.
Mechanistic precedent for a hypothetical drug is not proof of clinical harm.
The simulation output is a screening priority signal, not a validated probability.
